A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' worked as a [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] on<ref name="Creatures">{{WEGCite|book=Creatures of the Galaxy|story=The Ride Of A Lifetime}}</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Deminol]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Creatures" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The biologist was introduced in "[[The Ride Of A Lifetime]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Creatures" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
